enchantments.tooltip: Concentration -50: Passive: -50 penalty to the Concentration skill.
Speed XV: Passive: +30% enhancement bonus to movement speed, +15% enhancement bonus to ranged attack speed.
Stealth Strike: Reduces the threat generated by ranged attacks and spells by 15%.

Insightful Sneak Attack Bonus +4 : Provides a +4 Insightful modifier to your attack bonus and a +6 Insightful bonus to damage for any attack that would qualify as a Sneak Attack, even if the wielder is not a Rogue.
Doubleshot 8%: Passive: 8% Enhancement bonus to Doubleshot. (Doubleshot is a chance to score an additional hit with a ranged attack.)
